texts.title: Paste this into your agent’s MCP settings
texts.where: Cline, LM Studio, Continue, Goose and others: open their MCP settings and paste the "third-wheel": { … } part inside "mcpServers". Some stop a tool after 60 s: raise that limit if it has one (waiting for your review takes longer). ChatGPT and Ollama alone can’t use it. Details: docs/user-guide.md, “Other AI agents”.
